objective: Validate whether pre-cutoff search-to-cart progression adds purchase-intent signal beyond Baseline V2-2 raw search activity.

transition_policy.note: V2-3b keeps V2-2 raw search activity features and adds only aggregate pre-cutoff search-to-cart transition context. It does not use raw query text, product/category linking, sessionization, trends, query semantics, embeddings, or target-window events.
